note: Fallback people-lines for juice events whose payload carries no line. Short, in-voice, never shaming.

unspoken: Something's different. I can't say what.
letter: A letter came. I read it twice.
rumor: Did you hear? They're saying things again.
Word's travelling. Warm word, for once.
doctrine_voice: The way things are done here, that's the way.
We don't ask. We never did.
doctrine_suppressed: Best keep that one quiet now.
The old words are heavier today.
doctrine_swap: New words in the square. Same hungry faces.
notoriety_rise: People are talking about the one with the full purse.
notoriety_attractor: Strangers on the road. Don't look long.
stash_theft: Did you see? Somebody's been in the cellar.
A door left open. That's all I know.
stash_hidden: Under the boards, then. I never saw a thing.
It'll keep down there. I won't ask.
stash_stored: Down with the rest of it. Mind the damp.
stash_guard_hired: Someone's watching it now. They'll want paying every dawn.
A guard, is it. Must be worth guarding.
stash_withdrawn: All of it? Then it's just a cellar again.
Up it comes. Heavier than it looked.
stash_guard_left: Your guard's gone. Wages, they said.
stash_decay: Something's spoiling down there. You can smell it.
